newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungagent AGM approves capital doubling.
newsitem.headline: Hungagent AGM approves capital doubling.

text.p: Hungarian asset handling company Hungagent Rt's shareholders approved a capital increase of a maximum 224 million forints from 224 million, a company official said on Thursday.
"If the capital increase is successful, we will probably announce improved plans for this year," Gabriella Kajtar, Hungagent's finance director, told Reuters.
Details of the capital increase are yet to be worked out.
She said the company plans to swing to an operating profit of 30 million forints in 1997. In 1996, Hungagent had an operating loss of 18.3 million forints.
Hungagent, due to losses incurred during the last years, is exempt of tax, she said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, Hungagent shares closed at 1,150 forints on April 9.
